note: v4 rebuild (adv-20261030-one-piece-fortnite-hold, Mohammad 30 Oct 21:40 Dubai). Footage: Fortnite's official Treasure Hunters trailer (Epic Games, from Fortnite's X post, 1280x720), one continuous stretch 4.4 to 24.2 s in source order. Full-frame treatment composed as a picture track (live/2026-10-30/fn/fn-th-frame.mp4): solid template ground #141332 above (0 to 694, chip, headline, credit) with a 4 px azure rule, the trailer at 2.0x (the cap) in 1080x1200 at y 700 to 1900 (62.5% of the frame height), cropped to source rows 30 to 630 so the trailer's burnt-in English subtitles and its rating icon are out of frame; no blur anywhere. Sound: our bed. Reason: the trailer's English narration runs under every line from 4.4 s to the end slate (speech check: 'Your fortune favors stranger shores', 'A land of adventure', 'Danger', ...), no music-only stretch exists, and this is the only official copy outside YouTube (Fortnite's X post).
